message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: leaf picking poppy fruit (罂粟果) and planting in own field, later police found 782 mature poppy plants, removed them. The defendant voluntarily surrendered and confessed.

This is illegal cultivation of opium poppy, which is a narcotic plant. Under Chinese criminal law, "非法种植毒品原植物" (illegal planting of drug raw material plants) is a crime. The examples earlier: "非法种植毒品原植物" used for case of poppy planting. So the appropriate charge is "非法种植毒品原植物". Possibly also "非法持有毒品" but the act is planting, not possession. The crime is "非法种植罂粟" which falls under "非法种植毒品原植物罪". So answer: [罪名]非法种植毒品原植物<eoa>

Check if any other crimes like "走私" etc. No. So single crime.
